messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] eu-west1 control-plane errors increasing: apiserver 5xx rising, controller-manager queue depth +120% :warning:
mira.sre: noticing a spike in apiserver errors and a bunch of controller-manager retries. kubelet logs show AttachVolume timeouts on multiple gpu nodes
zac.net: checking network egress from nodes -> seeing lots of short-lived outbound connections to model-repo.redwood.ai (port 443) from onboarding jobs
rachael.prod: customers reported delayed Dedicated scale-ups, some jobs in Pending for >10m
infra-automate: quick inventory: nat-concentrator-eu has SNAT port utilization at 97% across 4 CGWs; conntrack entries near nf_conntrack_max on two gateways
mira.sre: can we confirm if this is new traffic pattern or a leak?
zac.net: looks like a burst of parallel downloads from a single job that does model prefetch across many pods -> ephemeral connections per pod ~= 3200 in short window
oncall-sre: potential mitigation options?
rachael.prod: can we throttle the onboarding prefetch in product? Might be quick fix
infra-automate: immediate infra mitigation: 1) split egress across additional CGWs, 2) increase conntrack_max on overloaded gateways, 3) add short-term SNAT port pool expansion
mir.a.sre: prefer split + throttling rather than rotate IPs which will interrupt flows
zac.net: starting a canary: bring up nat-cgw-eu-5 and move a few subnets; also flipping on conntrack_autoscale alerting (experimental)
deploy-bot: terraform apply plan-2026-03-21-nat-scale initiated

zac.net: quick shell dump:
```
# ss -tan state established sport :443 | wc -l
11234
# cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
262144
# grep ModelPrefetch workers.log | tail -n 5
2026-03-21T09:41:02Z prefetch start pod/gpu-init-23
2026-03-21T09:41:05Z prefetch start pod/gpu-init-24
2026-03-21T09:41:07Z prefetch start pod/gpu-init-25
```

mira.sre: controller-manager logs showing retry storms and longer leader election delays:
```
E0321 09:42:12.332 controller.go:731] reconcile failed for gpu-pool-eu: Post "https://apiserver.internal/api/v1/namespaces/infra/pods": dial tcp 10.0.12.45:6443: i/o timeout
```

rachael.prod: starting statuspage note draft: "Investigating provisioning delays in eu-west1, no data-plane interruptions reported"

oncall-sre: mitigation in progress: moved 20% of subnets to nat-cgw-eu-5, conntrack on overloaded CGW dropping from ~250k -> 150k, SNAT ports freed up :thumbsup:

infra-automate: after move apiserver p95 latency down to baseline, controller-manager backlog decreasing. GPUs attach durations returning to normal for most pods

mira.sre: agree. follow-ups: - add egress shaping for onboarding jobs (limit concurrent connections per pod) - add conntrack autoscale or per-cgw alert - evaluate increasing ephemeral port ranges vs. per-customer egress isolation - add test in rollout that spikes model fetches during attach tests

rachael.prod: I'll coordinate customer comms and check if any Dedicated customers want credits for delayed scale-ups
oncall-sre: leaving a temp runbook in ops-runbooks: how to detect and remediate nat port exhaustion quickly

deploy-bot: incident mitigated. ticket INC-2026-315 created
mira.sre: assigning postmortem to infra + platform teams, tagging for controller-manager owners and product for throttling change

zac.net: adding small PR to onboarding service to add randomized backoff + concurrency limit for model prefetch
oncall-sre: thanks everyone — keeping thread open for notes, but marking as mitigated for now :white_check_mark:
